description: One manual addition or edit of a punch, or of a day's attendance record (slice 088d; the name says Punch for history), made by a person, with the reason code they gave. Append-only: it is the record behind the monthly change notice. Written only by alvoraa_portal.punch_change, and only while the organisation's notice switch is on. Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: server code, a migration patch or a database login can still change or remove a row without a trace in the app.

fields.label: Punch
fields.description: The name of the Employee Checkin this is about, or blank when the row is about a day record (then 'Attendance' is set). Kept as text and not as a link, so the row outlives the punch.

fields.label: Day Record
fields.description: The name of the Attendance this is about, when the row is about a day record. Text, not a link, so the row outlives the document.

fields.label: Reason
fields.options:
Employee forgot to punch
Punch machine was down or offline
Wrong direction (in and out swapped)
Duplicate or accidental scan
Employee not yet enrolled on the machine
Employee was on approved duty away from the machine
Other
fields.description: DRAFT LIST. Needs sign-off before the notice switch is ticked on any tenant (slice 088, 00b section 3.3).

fields.label: Reason Text
fields.description: Only with the reason 'Other'. Up to 100 characters. Printed on the employee's notice.

fields.label: What changed
fields.description: One plain English sentence, the same words the printed notice uses.

name: Alvoraa Punch Change
